questions.question: What was the total number of Medicaid enrollees across all states reported in the national totals row for June 2025 (updated in February 2026)?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_new_adult_group_enrollment.csv')
filtered = df[(df['State'] == 'Totals') & (df['Enrollment Year'] == 2025) & (df['Enrollment Month'] == 6) & (df['Updated Year'] == 2026) & (df['Updated Month'] == 2)]
val = filtered['Total Medicaid Enrollees'].iloc[0]
result = int(str(val).replace(',', '').strip())

questions.question: For June 2025, according to the update from February 2026, which state had a larger count of VIII group enrollees: Washington or West Virginia?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_new_adult_group_enrollment.csv')
subset = df[(df['Enrollment Year'] == 2025) & (df['Enrollment Month'] == 6) & (df['Updated Year'] == 2026) & (df['Updated Month'] == 2)]
wa_val = float(str(subset[subset['State'] == 'Washington']['Total VIII Group Enrollees'].iloc[0]).replace(',', ''))
wv_val = float(str(subset[subset['State'] == 'West Virginia']['Total VIII Group Enrollees'].iloc[0]).replace(',', ''))
result = 'Washington' if wa_val > wv_val else 'West Virginia'

questions.question: In the February 2020 update for September 2018 enrollment, did any VIII group enrollees qualify as newly eligible in Vermont?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_new_adult_group_enrollment.csv')
row = df[(df['State'] == 'Vermont') & (df['Updated Year'] == 2020) & (df['Updated Month'] == 2) & (df['Enrollment Year'] == 2018) & (df['Enrollment Month'] == 9)]
val = float(str(row['Total VIII Group Newly Eligible Enrollees'].iloc[0]).replace(',', ''))
result = 'yes' if val > 0 else 'no'

questions.question: For September 2018 enrollment as recorded in February 2020, what was the total combined count of newly eligible VIII group enrollees across Ohio, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_new_adult_group_enrollment.csv')
subset = df[(df['Updated Year'] == 2020) & (df['Updated Month'] == 2) & (df['Enrollment Year'] == 2018) & (df['Enrollment Month'] == 9)]
states = ['Ohio', 'New Jersey', 'Pennsylvania']
subset_states = subset[subset['State'].isin(states)]
result = int(subset_states['Total VIII Group Newly Eligible Enrollees'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float).sum())
